summary: Work item #61's build gave up after 3 attempts: the runner's sandbox blocked the full runner-host tests and the desktop typecheck, so the generic container-runtime wording never landed and NO_MAC_CONTAINER_LINE on main still named OrbStack alone. This check keeps the OrbStack-only wording from coming back once #61 merges.

cases.content: export const NO_MAC_CONTAINER_LINE = `${NO_MAC_CONTAINER} (OrbStack is not answering): start it, or set checks.weakerMacSandbox`;

//   - macOS without one: nothing runs ("not run: this Mac runner has no
//     container runtime (OrbStack isn't answering): …")
export const NO_MAC_CONTAINER_LINE = `${NO_MAC_CONTAINER}; no container runtime is answering (Docker Desktop or OrbStack): start it, or set checks.weakerMacSandbox`;
* The `docker` CLI a container runner uses: runner.json's, else on PATH, Homebrew's, OrbStack's
